name: Rapunzel
source:
A mature girl. She has a modest, soft demeanor and a graceful, intelligent posture.

Her profile is serene and calm, but also somewhat resigned, decadent, and desperate. Her gaze is clear and vacant, with the eros of a bud that had been forcibly made to bloom.

She never leaves her hospital room, but recognizes the people who visit her as her adoptive guardian, "Grandmother Gothel".

Her long hair always hangs from the window, but...
